result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback: any commitment is confined to the applicable current 12-month term, may be reduced on 30 days’ notice, and does not survive termination. It also replaces take-or-pay liability with a non-penalty true-up tied to Services actually ordered. The changes are targeted and preserve the concept of an Order Form-based commitment. Drafting is generally professional, although “shortfall” being settled through Fees for Services actually ordered is somewhat unclear because those Fees may already be payable; the true-up calculation could be stated more precisely.
